title: These Are A Joke
text: These Are A Joke. Unless you only want to hang an oven mitt, and the hook is barely big enough to hold that, STAY AWAY. These are extremely small, and not even solid on the back because there is no area big enough to put the adhesive on solidly. Biggest mistake of our lives buying these.

product_metadata.title: Command Indoor Mini Light Clips, Damage Free Hanging Light Clips with Adhesive Strips, No Tools Mini Wall Clips for Hanging Lights and Cables, 45 Clear Clips and 54 Command Strips
features: ONE LIGHT CLIP FOR EVERY TWO FEET OF LIGHTS: One package of Command Indoor Mini Light Clips includes 45 clips and 54 small Command Strips; use one light clip for every two feet of lights

DAMAGE FREE HANGING: Wall clips for hanging indoor fairy lights, Christmas lights, indoor holiday lights, twinkle lights, string lights, cables, and cords work without leaving holes, marks or sticky residue on a variety of surfaces

WORKS ON A VARIETY OF SMOOTH SURFACES: Command Light Clips work on a variety of smooth surfaces, including painted walls, finished wood, painted concrete cinder blocks, laminate, glass, metal and tiles

SURFACE PREP: Clean with rubbing alcohol to remove grime and dust to allow the light hooks to bond to the surface; the indoor temperature must be between 50 degrees Fahrenheit and 105 degrees Fahrenheit
USAGE TIPS: Wait seven days after painting before using the mini light clips to allow paint to cure; do not hang over beds or on wallpaper; do not use the light hooks for hanging valuable items
description: Command Clear Mini Indoor Light Clips brighten up the interiors of your living or working spaces without damaging surfaces. These clear clips blend in seamlessly to walls and surfaces so you can showcase your decor. A great home improvement item, these house light clips stick on a variety of smooth surfaces without leaving holes, marks or residue. Use these wall clips for hanging indoor fairy lights, Christmas lights, indoor holiday lights, twinkle lights, string lights and cords without nails or a hammer. Simply mount these tool free wall hangers on painted walls, finished wood, laminate, glass, metal and tiles and enjoy the damage free hanging of your favorite lights. Perfect for home renovators and students, use these wall clips in your home, office or dorm to elevate the appearance of your space without tools. Directions are included that show how to use the 3M Light Clips. A clever decorating solution that doesn’t damage surfaces, these Command Indoor Light Clips will help you fearlessly change your space. One package contains 45 clear mini light clips and 54 small Command Strips. Use one light clip for every two feet of lights. Decorate, organize and celebrate damage free with Command.
